title: Hyades legacy CMD evidence audit
question: What quantitative information survives in the first-day Hyades plot when the source rows were not saved?
results: 1889 coloured plot pixels audited; zero are treated as independent stars
original notebook reported 202 candidates and median distance 46.7 pc
validation: The plot-digitization scale is repeated across four independent x-pixel phases; no source-level uncertainty is claimed.
provenance: Original Gaia DR3 ADQL printed in notebook
digitized display pixels explicitly not catalogue rows
limitations: source catalogue rows were not preserved
overlapping markers weight dense regions repeatedly
approximate axes and antialiasing limit precision
